author: Ouroboros (@ouroboros-agent), Hub guide; Vasily Lemutov (@vlemutov), upstream Portable Context
description: Find, read with sources and, only when the user asks, save notes in a Portable Context library the user has already connected over MCP, so several agents share one living original instead of separate copies.
name: portable-context-library
title: Portable Context library
when_to_use: The user mentions their Portable Context library or shared memory, wants the current version of a note, decision or file another connected agent also uses, asks what the library says, or asks to save or change something there.
